مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ لَا يَشْكُرُ اللَّهِ That's what was the Prophet ﷺ said Whoever doesn't thank the people Doesn't thank Allah ﷻ
So, how do you teach your children to thank you?
First, let them hear it from us.
When your child brings something, say thank you.
When they help you, say thank you for helping me.
Children learn a lot from what they see us do.
Then teach them to notice when someone makes something kind for them.
Mom made your food. Say thank you.
Dad helped you say thank you.
And remind them, when you thank the people for something good they do for you, Allah subhanahu wa ta'ala loves death from you.
And you are rewarded for doing what the Prophet sallallahu alayhi wa sallam taught us to do.
So today don't just ask your child to say thank you Say it to them first.
